question: Select the most appropriate option for blank(1)
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**offers**" means to present or proffer something for someone to accept or reject as desired. (प्रस्तावित करना)
 
• The phrase **"the history of psychology (1) offers the opportunity"** makes logical sense as it suggests that history provides a chance to learn or understand something.
 
• The other options: "**pieces**," "**makes**," and "**talks**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

**Complete Sentence:** Psychology is an exciting field and the history of psychology **offers** the opportunity to make sense of how it has grown and developed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pieces (टुकड़े)**: means parts of a thing, not suitable for the context here as it doesn't align with "the history of psychology"
 
• **Makes (बनाना)**: means to create or form, less natural in this context
 
• **Talks (बातें करना)**: means to speak, not fitting in the given sentence structure
